decode_cases.purpose: Controls may be hidden, user-defined think markers must remain; distinguish HF skip_special from llama special boolean.
Keep BOS, EOS, EOG and rendering policies distinct.
All twelve user-defined spellings survive either mode.
Reserved tokens carry actual CONTROL types.

streaming: For all valid UTF-8 raw texts, compare whole-sequence decoded bytes and every token-boundary incremental stream against the reference; do not replace partial UTF-8 per token with U+FFFD. Invalid arbitrary token byte sequences need an explicitly chosen byte/string API contract.

template_cases.purpose: NUL/think deletion versus role escaping; tool markers are not all escaped.
Tools with consecutive leading system messages, only-system messages, and no messages; compare tool-preamble placement and serialized JSON bytes.
Assistant multiple tool calls with string, integer, bool, array, object and Unicode argument values; tool response with role-marker text.

stop_cases.purpose: Record the chosen contract. Check each terminal ID independently, before rendering, and do not treat </think> or </tool_call> as an implicit generation end.
